info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Telecom Sim Esim Status-v1-spec
info.description: The Telecom SIM and eSIM Status Retrieval API allows users to access the current status of telecom SIM and eSIM devices. This API provides essential information regarding connectivity, activation status, and usage metrics, enabling service providers and end-users to effectively manage their telecom resources. Typical consumers of this API include telecom operators, customer support teams, and application developers building telecommunication solutions. By retrieving real-time data, businesses can make informed decisions and enhance user experience.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of the eSIM.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to obtain the current status of the eSIM associated with a user's account, providing insights into activation, connectivity, and any potential issues affecting the eSIM's performance.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the current status of the eSIM. It is essential for checking operational details and health of the eSIM services.
